Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District is soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District. The specifications listed in the RFP represent the minimum hardware requirements for each tier of device. Purchases may also include a variety of device accessories ordered in a bundle along with the devices, such as sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables. As stated in the solicitation, "This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors."
